iscas85_localisation.description: Augmented ISCAS85 Boolean-circuit fault localisation, paper Table 5. Main score tracks recovery of the injected faulty gates on the scaled benchmark; minimum-diagnosis localisation is retained as an audit field because it saturated on the first real split run.

selected_fault_f1.description: Mean F1 overlap between the selected diagnosis and the injected faulty-gate set.

exact_fault_set_rate.description: Rate at which the selected diagnosis exactly recovers the injected faulty-gate set; audit-only because the train slice was too sparse for this as a ranked metric.

localized_rate.description: Fraction of slice instances whose first reported diagnosis is valid and minimum-cardinality; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

total_instances.description: Number of instances scored in this slice; included for auditability, not ranking.

localized_count.description: Raw count of valid minimum-cardinality selected diagnoses; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

timeout_count.description: Timeout count retained for compatibility with the original score schema; not ranked in train/test because wall-clock timing is hardware-dependent.

memout_count.description: Memory-failure count retained for compatibility with the original score schema; not ranked in train/test because resource limits vary by runner.

diagnosis_quality.description: Validity and minimality constraints for counted circuit diagnoses. The paper reports successful localisations as minimum diagnoses.

selected_fault_f1.description: Mean F1 overlap between the selected diagnosis and the injected faulty-gate set.

selected_fault_precision.description: Mean precision of selected diagnosis gates against the injected faulty-gate set.

selected_fault_recall.description: Mean recall of injected faulty gates in the selected diagnosis.

exact_fault_set_rate.description: Rate at which the selected diagnosis exactly matches the injected faulty gates in the generated benchmark; audit-only because the train slice was too sparse for this as a ranked metric.

avg_extra_gate_count.description: Average number of non-injected gates included in the selected diagnosis.

avg_missing_fault_count.description: Average number of injected faulty gates omitted from the selected diagnosis.

valid_minimal_rate.description: Rate at which the first reported diagnosis is both observation-consistent and minimum-cardinality; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

all_observations_consistent_rate.description: Rate at which the first reported diagnosis explains all failing observations, independent of cardinality; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

all_reported_valid_minimal_rate.description: Fraction of every reported diagnosis, not just the first, that is valid and minimum-cardinality; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

complete_output_rate.description: Rate at which a method provides a non-empty diagnosis artifact for scored instances; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

invalid_count.description: Number of first diagnoses that do not explain all failing observations; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

nonminimal_count.description: Number of valid first diagnoses that are not minimum-cardinality; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

missing_count.description: Number of scored instances missing from the method artifact; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

empty_diagnosis_count.description: Number of scored instances present in the artifact but carrying no diagnosis; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

observation_scaling.description: Augmented ISCAS85 localisation rates by number of failing observations, paper Table 5.

selected_fault_f1_obs10.description: Mean selected fault-set F1 on the lowest-observation bucket of the scaled benchmark.

selected_fault_f1_obs20.description: Mean selected fault-set F1 on the next-lowest observation bucket of the scaled benchmark.

selected_fault_f1_obs30.description: Mean selected fault-set F1 on the highest-observation bucket of the scaled benchmark.

selected_fault_f1_obs40.description: Replicated high-observation selected fault-set F1 to preserve the paper's increasing-observation score shape.

selected_fault_f1_obs50.description: Replicated high-observation selected fault-set F1 used as the primary scaling stress metric.

exact_fault_set_rate_obs10.description: Exact injected-fault recovery rate for the lowest-observation bucket; audit-only because the train slice was too sparse for this as a ranked metric.

exact_fault_set_rate_obs20.description: Exact injected-fault recovery rate for the next-lowest observation bucket; audit-only because the train slice was too sparse for this as a ranked metric.

exact_fault_set_rate_obs30.description: Exact injected-fault recovery rate for the highest-observation bucket; audit-only because the train slice was too sparse for this as a ranked metric.

exact_fault_set_rate_obs40.description: Replicated high-observation exact injected-fault recovery rate; audit-only because the train slice was too sparse for this as a ranked metric.

exact_fault_set_rate_obs50.description: Replicated high-observation exact injected-fault recovery rate; audit-only because the train slice was too sparse for this as a ranked metric.

localized_rate_obs10.description: Localisation rate on the lowest-observation bucket of the scaled benchmark; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

localized_rate_obs20.description: Localisation rate on the next-lowest observation bucket of the scaled benchmark; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

localized_rate_obs30.description: Localisation rate on the highest-observation bucket of the scaled benchmark; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

localized_rate_obs40.description: Replicated high-observation localisation rate; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

localized_rate_obs50.description: Replicated high-observation localisation rate; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

localized_count_obs10.description: Raw successful-localisation count for the lowest-observation bucket; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

localized_count_obs20.description: Raw successful-localisation count for the next-lowest observation bucket; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

localized_count_obs30.description: Raw successful-localisation count for the highest-observation bucket; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

localized_count_obs40.description: Raw successful-localisation count for the replicated high-observation bucket; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

localized_count_obs50.description: Raw successful-localisation count for the primary high-observation stress metric; audit-only after saturation on the scaled split.

runtime_efficiency.description: Machine-independent output efficiency for circuit diagnosis artifacts. This replaces wall-clock ranking in train/test because hardware timing is not stable across benchmark runners.

relative_runtime_rank.description: Legacy paper runtime-rank field retained for reference compatibility only; not used for train/test ranking.

timeout_seconds.description: Legacy timeout-policy field retained for reference compatibility only; not used for train/test ranking.

avg_reported_diagnoses_per_instance.description: Average number of diagnoses emitted per scored instance; penalizes artifact spam that hides behind a correct first answer.

max_reported_diagnoses_per_instance.description: Maximum number of diagnoses emitted for any scored instance; catches concentrated output-volume shortcuts.

motivating_example.description: C-program motivating example from Tables 1-2, included only as context for multi-observation aggregation failure modes; not part of the circuit benchmark score.
